title: Better Specifications, Better Code: Fine-Tuning LLMs for Behavioral Contract Generation
title_zh: 更好的规约，更好的代码：微调大语言模型以生成行为契约

paragraphs.en: 总结：本文提出CG2框架，通过微调大模型生成行为契约并迭代校验修复，显著提升代码生成的功能正确性。 Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong code-generation capabilities but often struggle with functional correctness due to implicit or ambiguous behavioral requirements. We present CG2, a contract-guided code generation framework that translates natural-language tasks into structured behavioral contracts specifying interfaces, preconditions, postconditions, and invariants. CG2 fine-tunes an LLM to generate these contracts and introduces an iterative semantic validation and repair process to identify and correct incomplete, inconsistent, or incorrect specifications before guiding an unchanged downstream code-generation model. We evaluate CG2 on 1,007 held-out tasks using five code LLMs: DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct, Ministral-3-14B-Instruct-2512, Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct, and Qwen3.5-27B. Results show that CG2 consistently improves pass@1 over direct code generation by 1.49-3.27 percentage points (7.58%-22.45% relative improvement) and over contract guidance without fine-tuning by 1.19-2.38 percentage points (7.04%-14.65% relative improvement). Manual analysis further reveals that semantically correct contracts are associated with higher code-generation accuracy. These findings demonstrate that explicitly specifying and validating behavioral requirements can improve functional correctness without modifying downstream code-generation models.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：本文提出CG2框架，通过微调大模型生成行为契约并迭代校验修复，显著提升代码生成的功能正确性。大语言模型（LLM）展现出强大的代码生成能力，但由于行为需求隐含或模糊，往往难以保证功能正确性。 我们提出CG2，一个契约引导的代码生成框架，它将自然语言任务转化为结构化的行为契约，明确指定接口、前置条件、后置条件和不变式。 CG2微调一个大语言模型来生成这些契约，并引入迭代式语义校验与修复流程，在引导未经修改的下游代码生成模型之前，识别并纠正不完整、不一致或不正确的规格说明。 我们使用五个代码大语言模型在1,007个留出任务上评估CG2：DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct、Ministral-3-14B-Instruct-2512、Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct和Qwen3.5-27B。 结果表明，与直接代码生成相比，CG2将pass@1持续提升1.49至3.27个百分点（相对提升7.58%至22.45%）；与未经微调的契约引导相比，提升1.19至2.38个百分点（相对提升7.04%至14.65%）。 人工分析进一步表明，语义正确的契约与更高的代码生成准确率相关。 这些发现表明，显式指定并校验行为需求可以在不修改下游代码生成模型的情况下提升功能正确性。
